name: EFI Connector AN6 to 3/8" Quick Connect (Threaded Style)
title: EFI Connector AN6 to 3/8" Quick Connect (Threaded Style)
description:
The EFI Connector AN6 to 3/8" Quick Connect (Threaded Style) is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. This Adapter is available in the following colors: Black, Teal

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
• Quick Connect: High-pressure fuel rail latch mechanism.
